summary: Verified restyled first-time Welcome/Name onboarding modal (heavy glassmorphism). All required checks passed: modal appears on fresh state, backdrop and modal carry expected classes (onboarding-backdrop name-onboarding-backdrop / onboarding name-onboarding), .name-onboarding-glow layer present, .name-onboarding-cta on Continue, computed backdrop-filter on modal = blur(34px) saturate(1.8) (>=20px requirement met), backdrop element blur(22px) saturate(1.6). Heading 'Welcome to Sky Sync' with em highlight (color rgb(168,240,224)) and copy 'What should we call you?' present. Interactivity: Continue disabled initially, enables after typing, closes modal and persists localStorage.mausam-user-name='Rahul'. After reload, no name-onboarding shown and welcome-greeting reads 'Good afternoon, Rahul'. Rename via profile-name-input to 'Meera' updates greeting immediately. Regression checks: hero data-atmosphere present ('cloudy-night'), Leaflet map container present, no console/page errors, mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow.

Consider adding a non-breaking space before <em> in NamePrompt h1 for cleaner accessibility text.
